formProposal.title: Build a form with AI
formProposal.help: The AI proposes a form with what repeats in the documents, and you review it. “Create draft” leaves it as a draft with document reading on: it is published like any form, and the AI never publishes nor approves it. Once it is published, these documents are read again with it.
